## Change and evidence

Describe the concrete record or correction, affected IDs, public sources and exact locators. Explain what remains uncertain and any change in legal posture or identity boundaries.

## Data handling

- [ ] Stable IDs, filenames and existing roster order are preserved, or intentional changes are explained.
- [ ] Source references resolve and quotations, publication dates and caveats remain accurate.
- [ ] Curation accurately distinguishes SEAL analyst work from AI-assisted compilation.
- [ ] Any media change includes original files and thumbnail variants.
- [ ] Public-record digest and import expectations are updated only for reviewed record changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private correspondence, contributor contact details or workstation paths are included.

## Validation

- [ ] `node tools/validate.cjs`
- [ ] `node --test tools/validate.test.cjs`

Paste relevant results. The website consumes this change through a separate sync PR after merge.
